strategy: 5-minute closed candles; SMA5/SMA20 entry; exit only when estimated net profit after entry and exit fees is at least 1.00 TRY (quote threshold 0.019909); USD/TRY source: Frankfurter reference rate; STRICT PROFIT-ONLY exits: sell only after at least 1 TRY estimated net profit after entry and exit fees; no stop-loss; max 10% initial balance per entry; max four positions
note: Paper simulation only; no real orders. Strict profit-only selling: no sale unless at least 1 TRY estimated net profit remains after entry and exit fees. No stop-loss; losing positions can remain open and tie up capital. FX and crypto quote sources can differ, fills are simulated, and 5-minute candles may miss intrabar order; a 1% stop-loss is checked on available candle lows; simulated fills can differ from real market prices. Zero-loss/profit and continuous trades are not guaranteed.
